messages.subject: bilat.symmetry - including semilandmarks as lm pairs
parts:
Dear everyone,
I am performing bilat.symmetry() function on landmark configuration of the ventral cranium which contains both fixed landmarks and sliding semilandmark. I am wondering if semilandmark pairs should be included in "land.pairs" argument of the function, besides fixed LM pairs. I performed the analysis in both ways (including just fixed LMs as pairs, and adding SLMs as pairs). The results seem more reasonable when I included SLMs, so I guess it is the right way to perform the function. However, I am looking for a validation from someone with more experience.
Mihajlo
